test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only 3 people are sitting between A and D when counted from the right of A. B is sitting 2nd to the left of D. F is sitting immediate to the right of C. E is not an immediate neighbour of D. What is the position of F with respect to G?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre.

Only 3 people are sitting between A and D when counted from the right of A.

B is sitting 2nd to the left of D. F is sitting immediate to the right of C.

E is not an immediate neighbour of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d41899171317ae695a74d303917dfdda9727b312273054858847620b894fc9c1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7c2a90df596af2ed1d35dc65e907f26d93d5e38740b573c0149334121e54a3.png] 

Thus, F is 3rd to the right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
